caption: Mount Pilatus, Lucerne
composition: Lucerne lakeshore looking southwest to the Pilatus massif · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the Lucerne lakeshore, Mount Pilatus rises as a steep, jagged limestone massif southwest of the city, with several rocky summits rather than one snow pyramid. The lake fills the foreground under gray light. This frame keeps to the open shore and does not use the Chapel Bridge or the Water Tower. The Open-Meteo model is overcast, with no rain.
